name: Satyananda Sarangi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Satyananda Sarangi is an Odisha-based poet whose work in English appears in journals including Shot Glass Journal and the Society of Classical Poets. An electrical engineering graduate of IGIT Sarang, he combines writing with a career in civil service. The Society’s results for its 2023 international poetry competition list both ‘Yet Another Year’ and ‘The School Bell’ among the honourable mentions.

His poems here use rhyme, repetition and compact endings to explore what experience can teach. ‘Every Loss is Fine’ tests consolation through a sequence of conditions, while ‘The Ancient Temple’ listens for human voices beneath enduring stone. In ‘The Awakened Verse’, remembered poems and their cadences give way to a speaker’s discovery of a voice through personally felt experience.
